seo.description: Meridian Bay Formulations has made skincare in North Charleston, South Carolina since 1998. Learn about our facility, certifications and team.

sections.headline: Skincare makers in the Lowcountry since 1998
sections.subhead: A family-owned manufacturer serving brands, spas and retailers across the United States.

sections.heading: Our story
sections.body:
Meridian Bay Formulations began in 1998 as a small lab making body lotions for coastal spas. Today we formulate, fill and label skincare, body care and hair care for brands of every size, from first-time founders ordering 250 units to established retailers buying by the pallet.

We still work the way we started: chemists talk directly with clients, small runs get the same care as large ones, and every batch is documented.

sections.heading: Our facility
sections.body: Formulation, compounding, filling and labeling happen under one roof in North Charleston, which keeps lead times short and quality consistent.

items.answer: Filled runs require a 50% deposit when you approve your label proof; the balance is due before shipping.

sections.body:
### What we collect
Information you submit in forms (name, company, email, phone, project details) and basic analytics data.

### How we use it
To respond to inquiries, fulfill sample and production orders, and, if you opt in, send occasional marketing emails.

### Your choices
You can request access to or deletion of your information by emailing hello@meridianbay.example. California residents have additional rights under the CCPA/CPRA. We honor Global Privacy Control signals.
